info.title: 然后呢？ (AndThen) API
info.description: Hackathon prototype backend. All routes under /api are project-defined; no external platform API is required.

bearerAuth.description: Opaque random session token. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored server-side.

post.description: Admin only. Creating an account is NOT author verification: no author_verifications row is written, and `author_verified` is always false.
